claim: An application can consume SES through explicit host, resolver, renderer, and operation boundaries without assigning transport, persistence, synchronization, authorization, or navigation to SES.
observations: host adapter, resolver, renderer adapter, and operation route are defined
external application concerns have explicit owners outside SES
stable semantic and operation identity is required across adapters
local-only scope matches the project protected-action profile
limitations: No framework-specific adapter or product integration is implemented
No transport, persistence, synchronization, or deployment behavior is exercised
